protocol.status: Local prospective protocol, fixed before new trajectory execution; not external preregistration
protocol.fall_detection: 5 ms endpoints; pitch in both models, additionally roll in native model
protocol.recovery: Original final-one-second dwell: abs(pitch)<=1 deg, abs(x)<=0.03 m, abs(vx)<=0.03 m/s, after nonzero pulse ends

boundary.source: results/robustness/results.json; archived LQR labels, no new tuning
boundary.interpretation: Discrete transition intervals only; test all cells and retain nonmonotonic labels. No universal disturbance threshold.

payload.gain_source: Existing results/comparison/gain_design.json; same Q/R, no fitting or new gain designs
payload.force_location: Combined body+payload COM. Native model splits the world-X force between torso and rigid payload in proportion to their masses, giving the same resultant and moment.
payload.geometry: Centred rigid cuboid; low locations can intersect the illustrative shell. This ideal mass arrangement is not a mounting design. Native chassis inertia remains additional.
payload.reduced_checks: Every load and both controllers, opposing_standard scenario, 0.5 ms RK4; compare against planar at same step. Also 48 acceleration/force checks per load.
payload.scope: Focused perfect-sensing extension: 4 of the earlier 24 ideal conditions per load; does not repeat sensor noise or load-estimate error studies.

audit.trigger: For each condition/controller, any three-way label disagreement between engines at 0.25 ms, or between 0.5 and 0.25 ms within an engine
audit.first_round: Repeat both engines on every triggered pair at 0.125 ms
audit.second_round: Repeat both engines at 0.0625 ms only if an engine changes label between 0.25 and 0.125 ms
audit.report: Report finest available labels, all initial labels, every refinement and any remaining last-two-step label changes. Persistent cross-engine disagreement is not repaired by fitting parameters.

protocol.primary: Paired fallen/not-fallen and three-way outcomes; differences in fixed-vs-exact conclusions between engines
protocol.secondary: Common-pre-fall trajectory differences; fall-time difference only when both fall; paired survivor torque effort; sampled contact and roll diagnostics
protocol.statistics: Deterministic finite grids. Counts are descriptive; no confidence intervals, population success probabilities or model-as-ground-truth claims.
protocol.tuning_budget: Zero. No adaptation of controller gains, geometry, friction, thresholds or grid after seeing new results. Audit selection follows the fixed rule above.
